title: Creamy Mushroom Soup
description: A comforting and flavorful soup made with sautéed mushrooms and a touch of herbed cream.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the Spanish olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the mushrooms and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add the chicken broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the herbed cream and season with salt to taste.
Ladle the soup into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley.
